title: Canonical object list
prompt: Write canonical(objects) returning a sorted list of (side,x,y,hp) tuples, preserving duplicates. Example: two identical units remain two tuples.
solution:
def canonical(objects):
    return sorted((u['side'],u['x'],u['y'],u['hp']) for u in objects)

title: Find the first strict mismatch
prompt: Write first_difference(live,sim) for tick-to-list-of-tuples dictionaries. Return earliest missing or unequal tick, else None. Compare sorted lists so ordering is irrelevant. Example: identical tick 0 but different tick 2 returns 2.
tests:
assert first_difference({0:[(1,)],2:[(2,)]},{0:[(1,)],2:[(3,)]})==2, 'Report earliest differing tick'
assert first_difference({0:[]},{0:[],1:[]})==1, 'Missing frames are visible failures'
assert first_difference({0:[(1,),(2,)]},{0:[(2,),(1,)]}) is None, 'Ordering alone is not a mismatch'

title: Report coverage and agreement
prompt: Write coverage(live,sim) returning {'compared':intersection size,'exact':equal values on shared ticks,'missing':symmetric-difference size}. Example: live={0:1},sim={0:1,1:2} gives 1,1,1.
tests:
assert coverage({0:1},{0:1,1:2})=={'compared':1,'exact':1,'missing':1}, 'Do not hide unobserved frames'
assert coverage({0:1,1:2},{0:9,1:2})=={'compared':2,'exact':1,'missing':0}, 'Count exactness separately from coverage'
assert coverage({}, {})=={'compared':0,'exact':0,'missing':0}, 'Empty traces have no evidence'
hint: The set operator ^ gives elements present on only one side.

title: Detect a toy mixed-time signature
prompt: Write mixed(observed,before,after) for equal-length numeric lists. Return True only if every observed value matches its corresponding before or after value, at least one matches only before, and at least one matches only after. Example: [1,4] from before=[1,2],after=[3,4] is True.
tests:
assert mixed([1,4],[1,2],[3,4]), 'A before-only and after-only component form a mixed signature'
assert not mixed([3,4],[1,2],[3,4]), 'A whole after-frame is a shift, not a mixture'
assert not mixed([1,9],[1,2],[3,4]), 'Unexplained values do not establish a torn-read signature'

title: A planted health defect
prompt: Write inject_hp(objects,index,delta) returning a deep-copied list with only the selected object's hp changed. Example: delta=-1 plants a one-HP mismatch without editing the original.
starter:
from copy import deepcopy
def inject_hp(objects,index,delta):
    # TODO: copy and modify one field
    return objects
solution:
from copy import deepcopy
def inject_hp(objects,index,delta):
    out=deepcopy(objects)
    out[index]['hp']+=delta
    return out
tests:
a=[{'hp':10,'x':4},{'hp':20,'x':5}]
b=inject_hp(a,1,-1)
assert b==[{'hp':10,'x':4},{'hp':19,'x':5}], 'Change exactly the selected health value'
assert a[1]['hp']==20, 'Preserve the original evidence'
b[0]['x']=99
assert a[0]['x']==4, 'All nested snapshots must be independent'
